newsitem.title: USA: TII says will return to profitablity.
newsitem.headline: TII says will return to profitablity.

text.p: TII Industries Inc predicted on Monday that it would return to profitablilty during the next quarter and that sales would exceed $50 million for the fiscal year.

In a statement accompanying the company's third quarter earnings results, Timothy Roach, TII president and chief executive said: "We are confident that TII will return to profitability during the fourth quarter and, that sales for the fiscal year ending June 27 will exceed $50 million."
TII reported a third quarter net loss of $2.3 million, or $0.31 per share, compared with a net profit of $1.8 million, or $0.23 per share, for the year ago period.
The company noted that its third quarter and nine month results reflected $3.0 million of restructuring and other charges previously announced.
TII designs and manufactures overvoltage surge protection, fiber optic and electronic products, principally for use in the telecommunications industry.
